title: Apple Music retry is not blocked by a timed-out queue request
acceptance: When setQueue times out in apple-music-adapter.ts, the pending-queue lock for that instance no longer blocks the next prepare, so Retry playback can try again without a page reload.
A test covers: setQueue never settles, prepare times out, the next prepare reaches setQueue instead of 'still finishing a previous queue request'.
nextAction: Owner moved to Ready on 2026-10-29 as Lane A, scoped by the owner to the queue-lock fix only. Draft PR #656 (fix/rf-124-resume-in-place) holds the work: the lane claims this record In progress on that PR at start and retitles #656 for RF-123. Rebase #656 onto main and keep only the apple-music-adapter.ts lock release and its test. Revert the runtime.ts resume-in-place change and its tests: it was written for RF-124, which #657 fixed another way and the owner verified on iPhone (Pause/Resume included), so it has no Ready. Drop #656's RF-124, RF-29, RF-108 and RF-128 record edits and its device-provider-matrix.md and tasks.md edits (main has since reworked those). If resume in place is wanted later (for example Resume speed under RF-128), it gets its own record and its own Ready. RF-128 and RF-147 share these playback files but need their own Ready before the lane touches them. Owner-gated (playback code): the PR needs owner-approved and the owner's iPhone check.

evidence.summary: Owner iPhone Safari 2026-10-28: after a hung setQueue, Retry playback and a fresh Start both showed 'The Apple Music player is still finishing a previous queue request for "Break Stuff"'. pendingQueueGenerations is cleared only in the setQueue promise's finally, which never runs when MusicKit never settles.
Open PR carrying the RF-123 lock fix and resume in place; needs a rebase after #657 merged (d81c0fc).

Owner instruction in session, 2026-10-29, published by PR #662: "Yes move RF-123 and RF-132 to Ready and brief them as Lane A and Lane B after start-session". RF-123 is Lane A (Apple playback, Phase 1). The owner then confirmed Lane A ships the queue-lock fix only, with resume in place dropped.
